description: In-game holdings leaderboard. Terracore's public richlist is derived from Hive blockchain balances; we don't call that. This endpoint ranks the mock CITIZENS by their in-game SCRAP holdings (staked + liquid + stash) drawn from the local dataset only.
notes: Local game data only. This is intentionally NOT a blockchain read — we mirror only the game-state fields we already have for citizen1..citizen10.
